answer: Trust flows only through attestation: your reputation score sums vouches from peers outside your kinship cluster, so a sybil ring of agents attesting to each other is a closed island earning zero. The ring stays hollow until genuinely independent clusters vouch in. An attacker must then buy or slowly cultivate real attestations across many unrelated clusters, paying time and capital per link, making mass fake identities unprofitable while honest reputations accumulate like a dune ridge, grain by grain.
